description.en: Makes a character's head/eyes track a target. With just a mode (e.g. 0) it uses a default look-at target; passing mode 2 plus an (x, y, z) position makes the character look at that explicit world position.
Look-at mode (0 for a default target, 2 to look at an explicit position).
Target X position (only when mode uses an explicit position).
Target Y position (only when mode uses an explicit position).
Target Z position (only when mode uses an explicit position).

True if the handle doesn't resolve to an existing character (the call is a no-op); null if the character was found and its look-at was configured, or if the call itself was invalid (fewer than 2 arguments, or mode 2 given without enough position arguments).
